findings.title: SignupPage/LoginPage need an explicit useLocation import
findings.location: design.md — Signup -> acceptance flow (web): SignupPage.tsx and LoginPage.tsx subsections
findings.problem: The design instructs reading the invite token via useLocation().search in both pages, but SignupPage.tsx and LoginPage.tsx currently import only { Link, useNavigate } from react-router-dom. The design only explicitly calls out adding the useLocation import for GuestOnly/AuthGuard, so a verbatim implementer hits a compile error in these two pages.
findings.fix: In the SignupPage/LoginPage subsections, change the import to `import { Link, useNavigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom"`, add `const location = useLocation();`, and read `new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("invite")`.

findings.title: LoginPage has two post-auth redirect sites; pin that both handlers change
findings.location: design.md — Signup -> acceptance flow (web): LoginPage.tsx subsection
findings.problem: LoginPage.tsx has two independent `setToken(data.token); navigate("/dashboard")` sites: handleSubmit (password) and handleGoogleCallback (Google). The design says '(password + Google)' but does not pin that inviteToken must be read once at component scope and the invite-aware redirect duplicated into BOTH handlers, risking the Google path silently dropping the token.
findings.fix: State: read inviteToken once at component top from location.search; apply `navigate(inviteToken ? '/accept-invite?token=' + encodeURIComponent(inviteToken) : '/dashboard')` in both handleSubmit and handleGoogleCallback.
